items.s: Brooks (groin) remained a full participant in Thursday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports. Brooks is still on injured reserve but appears to be tracking toward a Week 11 return against Baltimore on Sunday. Chuba Hubbard should remain head-and-shoulders above Brooks on the depth chart as the clear RB1 for Carolina, but the Panthers likely also want to use the rest of the season to see if Brooks can stay healthy for a stretch and produce when given opportunities. Brooks is worth adding in fantasy, but his role will need to be defined before plugging him in lineups.
Jonathon Brooks is practicing again on Thursday. Brooks continues to trend towards being activated for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Practices Fully Ahead of Ravens Game
items.s: Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) practiced fully Thursday, The Charlotte Observer's Mike Kaye reported. Carolina also listed him as a full participant on Wednesday's estimated report. Brooks took only scout-team reps last week after the Panthers opened his practice window on Nov. 11. Head coach Dave Canales said Wednesday he believes Brooks is ready, with activation from injured reserve still pending ahead of Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens. Brooks injured his groin against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 2 and went on injured reserve on Sept. 23. NFL Network reported at the time that he was set to undergo core muscle surgery. Following a week of limited practice participation ahead of the team's Week 10 win over the Saints, Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) logged a full session on Wednesday and was again seen practicing on Thursday, according to beat reporter Mike Kaye. Already in his third NFL season, Brooks' early career has been defined by injury, and following an offseason of sleeper hype, he lasted only two games before a groin injury landed him on injured reserve yet again. items.h: Jonathon Brooks (core) logs full practice Wednesday
items.s: Jonathon Brooks was a full participant in practice on Wednesday. Brooks had his practice window opened last week. He'll have a chance to be activated for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

Brooks (groin) was a full participant at Wednesday's walkthrough. Brooks was listed similarly last Wednesday before capping the week with back-to-back limited practices and receiving a doubtful tag for Week 10 action. He then was downgraded to out before this past Sunday's game at New Orleans. Brooks is seeking a return from injured reserve, where he's resided since after Week 2 due to core muscle surgery.

items.h: Panthers Believe Jonathon Brooks Will Be Ready to Return from IR in Week 11
items.s: Carolina Panthers head coach Dave Canales said that he believes running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen) will be ready to return from Injured Reserve in Week 11 against the Baltimore Ravens, per Nick Carboni of WCNC Charlotte. Brooks has been sidelined since Week 2 after undergoing core muscle surgery. The 23-year-old has had an injury-ravaged NFL career to this point, appearing in just five games across three seasons since being selected by the Panthers in the second round of the 2024 draft. Upon his return, Brooks could take some work away from Panthers RB1 Chuba Hubbard, who has averaged 21.3 touches per game in 2026. items.h: Jonathon Brooks Worth Adding as He Nears a Return
items.s: Carolina running back Jonathon Brooks (core) has still not returned to the field, but he's worth adding in some more fantasy leagues as that time nears. The running back has missed seven straight games now, allowing Chuba Hubbard to serve as the workhorse back in the meantime. Brooks managed to practice a bit before Week 10, but was eventually ruled out. His next chance to return will be Week 11 against the Ravens. Brooks got in the first two games of the season, tallying 30 rushing yards across nine carries and 43 receiving yards across two receptions and three targets. Jonathon Brooks has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints. Brooks had his practice window opened by the Panthers. He was limited in practice throughout the week.

Brooks (groin) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports. Brooks ended Week 10 prep with back-to-back limited practices, but he was tagged as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Panthers. The third-year running back is not quite fully recovered from a groin injury that landed him on IR in late September, so his next chance to suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22. Trevor Etienne, AJ Dillon and Anthony Tyus will continue to operate in rotational backfield roles behind Chuba Hubbard while Brooks is sidelined.

items.h: Jonathon Brooks Downgraded to Out vs. Saints
items.s: The Carolina Panthers have officially ruled running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen) out for the Week 10 game on Sunday against the division-rival New Orleans Saints, according to Joe Person of The Athletic. Brooks was listed as doubtful on Friday's final injury report, but after returning to practice this week, he will remain on Injured Reserve for another week. The oft-injured 23-year-old will now not be eligible to return for the Panthers until Week 11 at home against the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22. Jonathon Brooks is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Saints. Brooks had his practice window opened this week. He is unlikely to be activated for Sunday.

Brooks (groin) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at New Orleans after being limited in practice throughout the week, Kassidy Hill of the Panthers' official site reports. Brooks remains on injured reserve and isn't likely to be activated by the 4:00 p.m. ET deadline Saturday. He was listed as a full practice participant at the beginning of the week, but coach Dave Canales revealed Friday that there was a reporting error with Brooks and CB Mike Jackson (groin), both of whom should have been listed as limited. Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen), who remains on Injured Reserve, is listed as doubtful to play in Week 10 on Sunday against the division-rival New Orleans Saints, according to Joe Person of The Athletic. Brooks took scout-team reps at practice on Wednesday and Thursday but was erroneously listed as a full participant. Instead, Brooks was limited, and he is unlikely to come off IR on Saturday and play on Sunday in New Orleans. It means that he most likely will not return from IR until next week at home against the Baltimore Ravens in Week 11.
